Use the active exam priority from [../../.brain/NextSteps.md](../../.brain/NextSteps.md), [../../.brain/Progress.md](../../.brain/Progress.md), [../../.brain/ExamTracker.md](../../.brain/ExamTracker.md), and [../../combined-HAL-then-IOCL-plan.md](../../combined-HAL-then-IOCL-plan.md). Compare current date against HAL (06 Sept) and IOCL (24 Sept) before choosing depth.

For the requested topic:

- give compressed theory only (bulleted, high-yield, edge cases examiners love)
- list examiner-favorite traps
- give one dry-run or concept-check exercise (code/SQL/output prediction)
- give 3 to 5 short GATE-level MCQs with negative-marking simulation (+3/-1); do not reveal answers until student replies
- flag stacking value: is this double-value (HAL+IOCL), HAL-terminal (COA/DL/TOC/Compiler), or IOCL-only (Cloud/OOP/Web/Quant)?
- end with what should be updated in the brain if performance is weak (WeakAreas.md, Syllabus.md, ERROR-LOG.md)
